article.title: Magic visit Raptors Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Magic visit Raptors Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Orlando Magic (1-3, 11th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Toronto Raptors (3-1, third in the Eastern Conference) Toronto; Friday, 7:30 p.m. EDT LINE: Raptors -3.5; over/under is 226.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Orlando Magic travel to face the Orlando Magic in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. Toronto went 46-36 overall and 33-19 in Eastern Conference action a season ago. The Raptors gave up 111.8 points per game while committing 20.9 fouls last season. Orlando went 45-37 overall and 26-26 in Eastern Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Magic averaged 115.7 points per game last season, 22.0 from the free-throw line and 35.1 from 3-point range. The teams meet for the second time this season. The Raptors won 129-99 in the last matchup on Oct. 28. INJURIES: Raptors: Kawhi Leonard: out (knee), Nate Bittle: day to day (foot). Magic: Paolo Banchero: out (ankle), Jonathan Isaac: day to day (knee), Izaiyah Nelson: out (ankle), Noah Penda: out (hamstring), Jalen Suggs: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
